from sequence_utils import merge_sorted_lists


def test_merges_and_preserves_duplicates():
    assert merge_sorted_lists([1, 3, 5], [2, 3, 6]) == [1, 2, 3, 3, 5, 6]


def test_handles_empty_inputs():
    assert merge_sorted_lists([], [1, 2]) == [1, 2]
    assert merge_sorted_lists([1, 2], []) == [1, 2]
    assert merge_sorted_lists([], []) == []


def test_does_not_mutate_inputs():
    left = [1, 4]
    right = [2, 3]
    merge_sorted_lists(left, right)
    assert left == [1, 4]
    assert right == [2, 3]

import pytest
from pagination import paginate


def test_returns_one_based_pages():
    items = ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e"]
    assert paginate(items, 1, 2) == ["a", "b"]
    assert paginate(items, 2, 2) == ["c", "d"]
    assert paginate(items, 3, 2) == ["e"]


def test_page_past_end_is_empty():
    assert paginate(["a"], 2, 1) == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize("page,page_size", [(0, 1), (-1, 1), (1, 0), (1, -2)])
def test_rejects_non_positive_page_values(page, page_size):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        paginate(["a"], page, page_size)


def test_does_not_mutate_items():
    items = ["a", "b", "c"]
    paginate(items, 1, 2)
    assert items == ["a", "b", "c"]
